summary: SDK 58 upgrade regression (Expo 58 / RN 0.88.1 / React 19.3). Backend: 32/32 pytest pass (catalog, tests start/submit, guest/start, privacy, auth/account, admin, bookmarks). Frontend at 390x844, no page errors: login, guest, home categories (3), practice chips and exam rows, all 4 exam modes (chapter/mixed/mock/custom), quiz (options, prev/next, mark, timer counting down, Hindi toggle, close->confirm), submit confirm (cancel and submit), result, review, history, profile, privacy from login and from profile (back works), bookmarks, admin dashboard + add question (saved), sign out, delete account. The new RN Modal palette works: palette-sheet slides into view at the bottom (y=458..844) with the 'Question Palette' title visible. A palette-N tap jumps to that question and closes the sheet. A palette-backdrop tap closes it. Legend colors are right: answered is green rgb(22,101,52), review is gold rgb(212,175,55), unanswered is grey rgb(229,233,240) with a border. Hindi title shows. No SDK 58 regressions found. A few minor issues already existed before the upgrade.

minor.issue: 30 of 34 seeded questions have correct='B' and 4 have 'A'. Always choosing B gives about 88%, which makes the practice meaningless. Shuffle the options or vary the correct key in the seed.

ui_bugs.issue: The bookmarked state is local useState only and is never filled from GET /bookmarks. When the review screen is reopened, bookmarked questions show the outline icon. Tapping it sends POST again (no-op) instead of DELETE, so the user cannot un-bookmark from review. Reference: app/review/[sessionId].tsx:20-34

Guests can open Bookmarks from Profile. It calls /api/bookmarks without a token, gets 401 (react-query retries), then shows 'No bookmarks yet.' instead of a sign-in prompt like History does. Reference: app/bookmarks.tsx:15-18
Chapter-wise rows show raw chapter_id slugs ('percentage', 'number-series') instead of names. Hindi names are not used either. Reference: app/result/[sessionId].tsx:64

issues: While loading, the stat cards show 0 Users / 0 Questions / 0 Tests and 'QUESTIONS (0)', with no loading indicator. The real values appear 1-3s later. This misleads the admin.
The 'Saved!' message appears where it is scrolled out of view (below the fields), so there is no visible confirmation at the Save button.
A transparent Modal with animationType=slide also slides the dim backdrop up with the sheet. Consider animationType='fade' plus an animated sheet, or keep as is. This is cosmetic only.

react_native_issues.issue: The palette was moved to RN Modal, but @gorhom/bottom-sheet 5.2.14 is still in package.json and nothing imports it. Remove it to cut bundle and native dependency risk. Reference: /app/frontend/package.json
LogBox.ignoreAllLogs(true) hides all SDK 58 deprecation warnings in dev. Reference: app/_layout.tsx:15

action_items: Review screen: load the user's bookmarks (GET /bookmarks) to set the initial 'bookmarked' Set, so the toggle can remove bookmarks.
Bookmarks screen: for guests, show a sign-in prompt and disable the query (enabled: !!user).
Result chapter-wise: map chapter_id to chapter name / name_hi.
Admin dashboard: show loading placeholders instead of 0 while stats/questions load.
Seed data: vary the correct option key.
critical_code_review_comments: The quiz palette RN Modal sets onRequestClose (Android back works). The submit-confirm and delete-account dialogs are still absolute Views (known, not regressed).
theme.ts makeStyles now uses a local NamedStyles generic and compiles. Only 2 usages.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows passed; 3 minor pre-existing bugs

seed_data_creation: Recreated user_deltest02 + test_delete_token_456 after the UI delete test. Recreated the test_student_token_123 session (the UI sign-out deletes it server-side). Deleted the TEST_SDK58 question created via the admin form and the test bookmark.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Guest state is in memory, so page.goto() after guest login returns to /login. Navigate by tapping in the app. Chapter mode on the first chapter has only 1 question; use mode-mock (25 Q) for palette tests. Signing out via UI deletes the session token in the DB; recreate test_student_token_123 / test_admin_token_123 afterwards. The delete flow consumes test_delete_token_456 (recreate with mongosh). The admin form needs qf-subject-* then qf-chapter-* before qf-save is enabled.
rca_of_issue: Review bookmark: useState(new Set()) is never filled from the server, so the toggle direction is wrong for questions bookmarked earlier.
